text: Hey, Lukas. Got a minute? I was at the counter just now and heard your little story about the guy who missed an empty net from three meters. Was that supposed to be me?
Daniel, come on. That was about some Bundesliga striker from this week. If I wanted to talk about you, I’d say it straight to your face. Don’t take everything so personally.
Sure, whatever. It just sounded a bit too familiar, you know? Maybe next time you can keep your jokes about the Bundesliga and not make it sound like you’re talking about your own teammates.
If you want to hear Bundesliga stories, you’re in the wrong place. Relax, man. Not everything revolves around you or last Sunday’s miss. If you can’t handle some banter, maybe football isn’t for you.

I can handle banter just fine. There’s a difference between banter and taking cheap shots at your own team, though. If you’ve got something to say about my game, say it to me, not behind my back. That’s all I’m asking.

You think I’m wasting my time talking about your miss? Don’t flatter yourself. If I had a problem with you, I’d tell you right here, not gossip about you to others. Maybe focus less on what you think I’m saying and more on your next shot.

If you say so. Just realize how it looked from my side when you told that story right as I was standing there. Maybe you don’t care, but it’s not a great look for team spirit. Anyway, I’ll worry about my shots. You worry about what comes out of your mouth.

You done, then? Because I’m not here to babysit anyone’s feelings. If you’re going to get wound up over a story, that’s on you. Team spirit isn’t about walking on eggshells for every sensitive ego. I’ll keep saying what I want. If you’ve got a problem, deal with it.
